recording.title: Studio: Recording, Production, Mixing, and Mastering
recording.text1: At Elyon Studios Bcn, we offer our in-studio services to help you achieve your dreams — turning your ideas into a professional musical production. Studio services can be comprehensive (all-included) or cover only certain stages (like just recording, for example).
quests: Do you want to create your song from start to finish, from the initial idea in your head to a fully mastered track?
Do you just need professional-quality recording and plan to produce it yourself afterwards?
Have you already recorded everything and now want to produce, mix, and/or master your song?
recording.text2: Fill out the form and let’s talk about how to bring your new creations to life.

composition.text2: Fill out the form and let us know how we can support your project.

coaching.title: Vocal Coaching and Piano Lessons
coaching.text1: At Elyon Studios BCN, we also offer singing and piano sessions for artists looking to improve their musical skills, especially with a focus on future recordings. We have over 15 years of experience offering singing and piano lessons.
quests: We offer vocal coaching sessions to improve the quality of vocal recordings and provide plenty of tips on how to record vocals properly. We also offer modern piano lessons, especially geared toward singers who want to learn music and accompany themselves while performing their songs.
coaching.text2: Fill out the form to let us know what you're interested in so we can schedule your sessions.

description1.p1: Hi! I'm Pau Lefler, founder of ELYON STUDIOS BCN. I'm a musician, pianist, singer, vocal coach, composer, and music producer based in Barcelona. My passion for music has led me to build a diverse and multifaceted career, combining solid academic training with years of hands-on experience across various areas of the music industry.
description1.p2: I hold a degree in Musicology from the Autonomous University of Barcelona (UAB), I am a professional singer trained at the Liceu Conservatory, and I also earned a Modern Music and Jazz degree from Taller de Músics (ESEM). This education has allowed me to explore music from multiple angles: from theory and historical analysis to performance, composition, and modern improvisation.
description1.p3: In addition, I completed a Master’s degree in Film Scoring and Soundtrack Composition at EARTES (NEXO). Through this program, I gained extensive experience in music production, sound engineering, and mixing, working on projects that required the highest standards of technical and creative quality. This background has shaped my ability to combine cinematic storytelling, sound design, and emotional depth in every production.
description1.p4: A key aspect of my work is my background as a vocal coach, a role I’ve been passionately dedicated to for over 12 years. This has given me a deep understanding of the human voice and of the artistic and technical needs of singers. As a producer, this becomes a great advantage—I can work closely with vocalists throughout the entire creative process: from vocal composition to final recording, helping them bring out their full potential in every track.

about.description2: At ELYON STUDIOS BCN, I strive to offer a professional, welcoming, and inspiring environment where every project is treated with the utmost attention to detail. My mission is not only to deliver high-quality music productions, but also to provide artists with a transformative and empowering creative experience.
